issue_context.title: v0.21 filterableAttributes including distinctAttribute in addition to values set
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When both `filterableAttributes` and a `distinctAttribute` are set the `distinctAttribute` is being included in the `filterableAttributes`. In v0.20 the equivalent for `filterableAttributes` was `attributesForFaceting`, and when setting this the `distinctAttribute` was not included.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Run the following curl command:

```sh
curl -X POST 'http://localhost:7700/indexes/movies/settings' --data '{"filterableAttributes": ["year", "genre"], "distinctAttribute": "movie_id"}
```

With this `filterableAttributes` includes the `distinceAttribute` in addition to the values set:

```json
{
  "displayedAttributes": ["*"],
  "searchableAttributes":["*"],
  "filterableAttributes": ["genre","year","movie_id"],
  "rankingRules": ["words","typo","proximity","attribute","exactness"],
  "stopWords": [],
  "synonyms": {},
  "distinctAttribute": "movie_id"
}
```

**Expected behavior**
I didn't expect `filterableAttributes` to include `movie_id`

**MeiliSearch version:** [e.g. v0.20.0]
v0.21.0rc2

**Additional context**
Running the equivalent in v0.20.0 does not include the `distinctAttribute`

```sh
curl -X POST 'http://localhost:7700/indexes/movies/settings' --data '{"attributesForFaceting": ["year", "genre"], "distinctAttribute": "movie_id"}'
```
results in:

```json
{
  "rankingRules": ["typo","words","proximity","attribute","wordsPosition","exactness"],
  "distinctAttribute": "movie_id",
  "searchableAttributes":["*"],
  "displayedAttributes":["*"],
  "stopWords":[],
  "synonyms":{},
  "attributesForFaceting":["year","genre"]
}
```
comments:
Hi @sanders41! Nice spot! 👍

Indeed, the `distinctAttribute` should not appear in the list of `filterableAttributes` and can't be usable as is until it has been added as a `filterableAttributes`. 

Technically, we have to create a specific data structure for the `distinctAttribute` that makes it filterable but we want to prevent it. You can find more information on the related specification https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/32/files. Line 188 - 192.

review_comments:
Wait how was that compiling?

There is still a `faceted_fields` exposed by milli?
Yup :) According to our discussion we will rename faceted into aggregated.
